com.ibm.cos.v2.utils

Class AttributeMap.Key<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.utils.AttributeMap.Key<T>
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    ClientOption, DefaultSdkMetric, OperationMetadataAttribute, S3ClientContextParams, SdkHttpConfigurationOption, SdkHttpExecutionAttribute, TransferConfigurationOption, WaiterAttribute
    Enclosing class:
    AttributeMap

    public abstract static class AttributeMap.Key<T>
extends Object
    An abstract class extended by pseudo-enums defining the key for data that is stored in the AttributeMap. For example, a ClientOption<T> may extend this to define options that can be stored in an AttributeMap.
